The '''Gav Daragon''' was a [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] serving in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the subsequent [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Late in the Cold War, it served in the [[First Expeditionary Fleet]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] forces. It is named for [[Gav Daragon]], a Koros native [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] who discovered [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
